verdicts.note: She is the incumbent clerk (since 2019) after about two decades in Superior Court administration, and she runs on that expertise (S1, S2, S4). That is a maximal record case, and high confidence holds.

First-time write-in candidate with no office or court record. She says she ran 'to give voters a choice' and says of court, 'Obviously, I've never been there' (S2). The axis describes her profile, not her rhetoric, so +2 high holds even though she pitches her real-estate and customer-service experience rather than outsider themes.

'A careful steward of public resources, prioritizing needs over wants' (S1) is one clear restraint statement, which the guide rates medium. It is boilerplate and borderline, but direction and magnitude (-1) fit the restrain pole. Beaton's concern about budget-driven staff losses (S4) describes her office's situation, not a spending position, so leaving her unscored on spending is correct.
